record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, untie history and candidate embeddings into two full-rank 128-dimensional tables, initialized identically and independently trained. Retain unit normalization and zero padding for both; share the candidate table between positive and negative scoring. Separate representations may reduce conflicting input/output gradients without the capacity restriction of the unsuccessful rank-64 factorization. Preserve GRU topology, readout, scoring operation, loss and optimizer; update the predictor writer for matching checkpoint shapes.
